title: Coordination Correction Share of Order Reductions — Insurance Coverage & Claims
content:
**Insurance Coverage & Claims — coordination corrections (CO-22).**

## Clauses

1. The coordination correction's share of the order's reductions is the denial's amount divided by all the denied amounts on the claim where the remittance paid at least one line of the claim.
2. It is the denial's amount divided by the amount the claim billed at filing where no line was paid but the plan adjudicated a line to the member or to a contractual adjustment.
3. Otherwise it is one, the reductions being taken in full.
4. Under the coordination correction, the reductions are multiplied by the share.

"All the denied amounts on the claim" are the amounts of every denial line on the claim, the other-coverage denial included. A line adjudicated to the member is a member-responsibility line on the claim; a line adjudicated to a contractual adjustment is a contractual-adjustment line on the claim.

## Input, judgement, output (hypothetical claims)

| Remittance on the claim | Clause | Share |
|---|---|---|
| Paid 210.00; denied CO-22 120.00 and CO-151 80.00 | 1 | 120.00 divided by 200.00: 0.60 |
| Paid nothing; contractual adjustment 30.00; denied CO-22 270.00; billed at filing 300.00 | 2 | 270.00 divided by 300.00: 0.90 |
| Paid nothing; nothing adjudicated to the member or to a contractual adjustment | 3 | 1 |
